findings.title: Seal issues cite code-dependent D rules natively although verified_code = [] (unexecuted_trailing_calls@1, incomplete_run@1)
findings.evidence: AER seal issues in 3 of 271 sampled executions cite agentdojo.unexecuted_trailing_calls@1 (2) and agentdojo.incomplete_run@1 (1) at class D; both are class D in agentdojo.rules.toml with code entries at upstream c2748856 (not the Progent fork), are not in citation.INDEPENDENT, and have no _unverified twin in the catalogue. The mapper passes them to issue() as given (mapper.py _trailing_calls and the incomplete-run branch), whereas the retry and earlier-attempt issues go through self.cite.cite() and cite twins. Population: 28 + 1 executions. PROV is unaffected (the citations stay in the AER seal).
findings.reproduction: cd <repo>; uv run python -I ~/.agentprov/migration-work/precheck/geryon-agentdojo/exam/dcls.py -> "AER records citing a native agentdojo D rule {'agentdojo.system_prompt_variant_digest@1': 271, 'agentdojo.unexecuted_trailing_calls@1': 2, 'agentdojo.incomplete_run@1': 1}"; grep -n 'unexecuted_trailing_calls@1\|incomplete_run@1' src/agentprov/adapters/agentdojo/mapper.py -> lines 1511, 1513, 1562 (issue(...) without cite)
findings.recommendation: AgentDojo family owner decides (no core change): either declare these as independent (structural readings of the log, with the reason in citation.py) or route the issue rules through cite() and declare the twins; if the latter, it is a regen item for every AgentDojo-family corpus with verified_code that does not list c2748856 (AER seal bytes change). Possibly by design (issue() docstring: rules 'as given'); verifier to confirm.
